function.name: read_file
function.description: Read the contents of a file. If path is a directory, lists its contents.

path.description: Path relative to the repo root

function.name: run_command
function.description: Run a shell command with cwd already set to the current run workdir and return stdout+stderr. Use paths relative to that cwd. Do not prefix commands with `cd ... &&`; put the directory or file path in the command itself, e.g. `rg term src` or `bun test src/file.test.ts`.

function.name: str_replace_editor
function.description: Replace an exact string in a file with new content. old_str must match exactly (including whitespace). Use for editing source code.

old_str.description: Exact string to find (must match file content exactly)

function.name: create_file
function.description: Create a new file with the given content. Fails if the file already exists.
